title: I Pulled Down the King's Curtain. (Part 1)
summary: Fold follows a loose gold thread to free his street from the king's curtain and uncovers a sleeper on the mountain.
frame_0: Fold holds the gold thread beneath unraveling blue cloth. Nell and her potted sunflower stand in the foreground, with a gap of blue sky above the houses.
